items.summary: A boot-time process flaw in Secure Firewall Management Center allows authentication bypass with a perfect 10.0 CVSS. Confirmed in-the-wild exploitation by state-sponsored and criminal actors. See Cisco's advisory for fixed builds.
items.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center: CVSS 10.0 auth bypass exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-20079)
items.why_it_matters: Any customer running FMC for firewall management needs this patched now — exploited 10.0s on management-plane gear are how footholds start.

items.summary: Palo Alto published a critical PAN-OS advisory for an out-of-bounds write flaw. Fixed in 12.2.3, 12.1.10, and 11.2.13-h2 (branch-dependent). No confirmed exploitation yet, but it landed alongside Citrix and Check Point perimeter zero-days in the same week.
items.title: PAN-OS critical out-of-bounds write in XML parsing (CVE-2026-0310, CVSS 9.1)
items.why_it_matters: Perimeter-firewall week: three vendors, three critical edge flaws. Audit customer PAN-OS versions against the fixed trains before it becomes the next KEV entry.

items.summary: Dell launched a new Private Cloud offering with the Dell Automation Platform, supporting VCF 9.1, Azure Local, and Nutanix AHV on PowerStore. Positioned as the upgrade path for the massive partner-sold VxRail installed base, claiming up to 65% cost savings vs a five-node HCI cluster.
items.title: Dell Private Cloud with Automation Platform: hypervisor choice aimed at the VxRail refresh wave
items.why_it_matters: Dell calls the VxRail refresh one of the largest partner opportunities in years — and they're explicitly not opinionated on hypervisor. That's an opening for VMware-uncertain customers.

items.summary: Coverage this week shows continued VMware-to-Nutanix migration momentum — including Cisco FlashStack with Nutanix and a sovereign-cloud push targeting regulated deployments — while Red Hat and others ship their own alternative-stack updates.
items.title: Nutanix keeps gaining ex-VMware customers as rivals push alternative stacks
items.why_it_matters: The Broadcom displacement motion is still live deal flow. Know the Nutanix/Cisco counter-positioning for any customer still on the fence about VCF renewals.
